title: SUNRISE Titan Pack 26.2
description: A more saturated world with brand new models, entire new armor sets, tools, blocks, and much more to be descovered.
body: Hi, I'm Joel. I'm honored to present the new "SUNRISE Titan Pack", a new way to experience Minecraft without betraying its origins. A more saturated world with brand new models, entire new armor sets, tools, blocks, and much more to be descovered. Designed for those who want that extra touch missing from the base game texture, without changing its core aesthetic, but rather innovating it, making it more rustic and coherent. Whether you're an explorer, builder or farmer, whether you play in quiet solitude or in chaotic company, SUNRISE adapts to every type of gameplay. So have fun and play. For friends.
